title: AECBENCH: A HIERARCHICAL BENCHMARK FOR KNOWLEDGE EVALUATION OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN THE AEC FIELD

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated evaluation scores for open-ended documents against human expert scores using scatter plots to identify systematic scoring bias (e.g., the tendency to overestimate low-quality responses and underestimate high-quality responses), and measuring the reduction in mean absolute error after applying calibration methods like isotonic and piecewise linear regression.
